data.body: T3 change 2241 ps1 got Verified-1: CI ModuleNotFoundError collecting tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/classify/*.py ('rebar_reconciler.classify is not a package'). ROOT CAUSE (not a completion-verifier fault -> debug directive N/A; this is Gerrit CI): my E2E suite was placed in the interface-parity tier (tests/interfaces/store/) but imports engine internals (rebar_reconciler.coordinator/batch_dispatch/etc) via a raw sys.path.insert of src/rebar/_engine + eager top-level import. That tier collects BEFORE tests/unit and has no engine bridge, so it cached the PURE-engine rebar_reconciler in sys.modules, defeating the unit tier's hybrid-__path__ shadow bridge (tests/unit/conftest.py) that makes rebar_reconciler.classify resolve to the test-tree package -> classify collection ImportError. Reproduced locally with --collect-only (clean without my 3 files). FIX: relocated all 3 files to tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/ (sibling of the reused venue-cutover harness), removed the sys.path hack + noqa, marker interface->unit, harness import -> package-relative 'from ._coordinator_harness'. Verified: full-tree collect-only exit 0; mutate+classify+venue+census 51 passed; teeth re-confirmed (replay_safety_for mutation -> s8/s9 RED, restored); make lint exit 0; make typecheck clean. Updated a735 file_impact to the 6 relocated paths. Amended (Change-Id preserved) + pushed ps2.
